updates.html:
1 · Find the entry. If the page is unknown, call get_basic_info with fileId to read its explicit page list. Find AGENT README. The user-active page may be an archive; it does not select your source.
2 · Read a bounded guide. Request the exact guide page. Use find_nodes with fileId, nodeId: agent_entry.node_id, textValue: * when that node is known; otherwise use its explicit pageId. Do not run an unscoped whole-file text scan.
3 · Follow the assigned route. Read the exact destination page's returned artboards, then the relevant contract or product board. Use get_jsx on verified product board IDs for UI extraction; an empty page-root JSX is not proof of an empty page.
4 · Use result. Confirm returned file/page IDs. document.basic_info can describe another user-active page. document.snapshot_sha256 is only a mutation drift guard, not a revision, permission or writer lock.
